caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a rounded body, a narrow neck, a flared spout, and an attached handle. The jug is rendered in shades of gray, imitating the appearance of salt-glazed stoneware. Blue decorative motifs, including a band of leaves or floral elements, encircle the upper portion of the jug’s neck and are repeated in a larger pattern on the body. The handle is curved and connects the neck to the shoulder of the jug. The jug stands upright on a plain, off-white background with no other objects or details present.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
